t: A no-solder breadboard kit with ten guided experiments for the BBC micro:bit.
steps: Buy the kit from a maker shop such as The Pi Hut or RobotShop.
Get a BBC micro:bit and a micro USB cable, which are sold separately.
Fix the breadboard and edge connector to the plastic plate with the screwdriver.
Open the free MakeCode editor in a web browser.
Follow the first experiment in the printed book to light an LED.
Download your program and drag the file onto the micro:bit drive.
Try experiment 2 online to read the light sensor.
Move on to the motor experiment and the online MicroPython versions.
meta: Open Code. From $28.56. A few stores.
